assumptions: For supplied binary-spin graph energy H(x)=-sumJ_ij x_i x_j-sumh_i x_i, retain three same-temperature replicas and reassign their sitewise spin multisets jointly. At each mixed site let majority sign s_i and minority replica label c_i in{0,1,2}; x_i^(a)=s_i[1-2 1(a=c_i)]. Local-field and unanimous-site edges stay constant; mixed edges obey sum_a x_i^(a)x_j^(a)=s_i s_j[-1+4 1(c_i=c_j)]. Conditional recombination is exactly a signed three-state Potts law with coupling K_ij=4J_ij s_i s_j. Exact conditional heat-bath resampling preserves joint equilibrium but is not generally ergodic. This is an internally derived identity and scoped primitive, not a novel general solver or measured mixing advantage.
contract.interface:
For supplied binary-spin graph energy H(x)=-sumJ_ij x_i x_j-sumh_i x_i, retain three same-temperature replicas and reassign their sitewise spin multisets jointly. At each mixed site let majority sign s_i and minority replica label c_i in{0,1,2}; x_i^(a)=s_i[1-2 1(a=c_i)]. Local-field and unanimous-site edges stay constant; mixed edges obey sum_a x_i^(a)x_j^(a)=s_i s_j[-1+4 1(c_i=c_j)]. Conditional recombination is exactly a signed three-state Potts law with coupling K_ij=4J_ij s_i s_j. Exact conditional heat-bath resampling preserves joint equilibrium but is not generally ergodic. This is an internally derived identity and scoped primitive, not a novel general solver or measured mixing advantage.

If the OBSERVED mixed graph is a forest, established three-label dynamic programming samples in linear arithmetic work after graph/replica acquisition; treewidth t costs tables~3^(t+1). Favorable observed structure is not demonstrated for difficult frustrated systems. With multiset{+,+,-} everywhere and J=-1, total energy=-|E|+4 times monochromatic edges; reaching-|E| is exactly graph three-colorability. Thus unrestricted zero-temperature exact reassignment hides graph coloring. This excludes an assumed free conditional solver, not every useful recombination algorithm or all positive-temperature samplers.

Agreeing replicas admit no new sitewise alternatives. Increasing replica count increases conditional alphabet binom(m,k); independent unbiased mixed fractions1-2^(1-m) grow from1/2 to3/4 to1023/1024 at m2,3,11. More replicas do not automatically sparsify the conditional graph.

Charge O(mN+E) input/storage and O(mN) explicit output,3^u general three-label enumeration, forest messages or treewidth tables, and cumulative probability precision (e.g.epsilon/u conditional TV per site). No analog ground-state or free physical equilibration is assumed. Producer audit exhausts243 recombinations of an8-site10-edge instance with5 mixed sites, exact integer energy error0 and double-precision Gibbs difference0; triangle27 and K4 81 labelings expose coloring endpoints. These verify finite algebra only. The final audit output was not rerun at bundle packaging;10 earlier checks were. Nothing was executed at intake.

Replica permutation/cluster ideas and tree dynamic programming are credited; a screened autonomous decoder idea already appears in literature and is not promoted. No external correctness, historical novelty, large-system useful mixing gain or physical capability is established. The decisive missing operation is a cheap nontrivial conditional reassignment for consequential frustrated regimes, tested with matched end-to-end costs.
